unit: same extracted sections for all methods
timing_protocol: One sequential pass, fixed method/query order. One synthetic Ollama warm-up excluded. GPU routing versus CPU MiniLM. Prefix caches are not cleared; timings are exploratory.
limitations: Budget counts whitespace words, not model tokens
MiniLM is primarily English; its default tokenizer truncates long section inputs
Latency is exploratory, not a controlled database performance comparison
Public test set; do not tune on reported test results
The base checkpoint is identified by Ollama artifact digest; exact upstream Hugging Face revision is not attested.
Non-thinking greedy decoding is fixed for reproducibility, not a claim of the model's optimal settings.
No fine-tuning or generated-answer scoring was performed.

served_artifact.base_revision_note: Ollama catalog digest identifies the served artifact; its exact upstream Hugging Face commit is not attested.
